other_conditions: Must hold a Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences.
Must have at least three years of post‑doctoral experience in Biotechnology.
Age limit is 40 years (with a 5‑year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates).
Post‑doctoral researchers without a permanent position may serve as Principal Investigator only if a senior faculty/scientist with a permanent position acts as Co‑Principal Investigator.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹30 lakh in research support for up to three years, plus a monthly fellowship of ₹45,000 with 10 % HRA for young scientists without a salary.
documents_required: Resumes of Principal Investigator and Co‑Investigators
Self Appraisal of the Principal Investigator
